ai_summary: Atlanta Electricals Limited reported strong Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results, with revenue growing 23.1% and 35.5% respectively, and PAT increasing 28.0% and 40.4%, supported by a robust ₹3,196.97 crore order backlog and strategic expansion initiatives. However, Q2 profitability faced material impacts, with EBITDA margin contracting by 201 basis points due to elevated commodity prices on firm-price contracts and temporary weather-related operational disruptions, leading to ₹180 crore in deferred deliveries. Management expects these headwinds to be temporary, with operations normalizing and improved execution anticipated in H2 FY27.
